Identify cards bought at WatsonTCG before tracking them

2026-10-20 · Updated 2026-11-10

To add a card bought from WatsonTCG to your collection, scan the individual card in the iPhone app or search by name, set and collector number on this website. Confirm the printing, language and finish, then record the copy you own in the app. WatsonTCG is a retailer; choose the card’s game when you scan.

Trading card identifier. · Explore the card catalog. · Trading card collection tracker.

Match the card to its game

For Pokemon, Magic: The Gathering, One Piece and Disney Lorcana singles, use the matching CardScanFox catalog and scan workflow:

  • For a Pokemon single, confirm the expansion, collector number, finish and language. Use the Pokemon card scanner.
  • For a Magic single, check the set symbol, collector number and foil or alternate treatment. Use the MTG card scanner.
  • For a One Piece or Lorcana single, confirm the artwork and variant against the suggested record. See the One Piece scanner or Lorcana scanner.

For sealed products, open the pack before cataloging the individual cards. Check the current app categories for other games, including Riftbound; this guide covers the four games above.

Scan after opening or buying a single

Photograph one card or add up to 10 camera or gallery items to the current scan queue. Review each suggested match before saving. Confirm the game, set, number, language, finish and raw condition or existing slab grade. Compare the price for the confirmed printing and condition; record the shop’s purchase price separately.

CardScanFox is an independent collection and price-checking app. This guide does not imply a partnership with WatsonTCG or access to its order records.
